scripts.dev:
if [ -n "$REPLIT_EXPO_SESSION_SECRET" ]; then
  if pnpm exec create-launch login --session "$REPLIT_EXPO_SESSION_SECRET"; then
    export EXPO_PUBLIC_REPLIT_EXPO_CLI_SESSION_STATE=ready
    echo '[WatchTime preview] Replit-managed Expo CLI session: READY'
  else
    export EXPO_PUBLIC_REPLIT_EXPO_CLI_SESSION_STATE=blocked
    echo '[WatchTime preview] Replit-managed Expo CLI session: NOT READY; refresh the Replit workspace, restart this workflow, and follow any managed sign-in steps in Preview on your phone. Do not use your Replit password as an Expo password.'
  fi
else
  export EXPO_PUBLIC_REPLIT_EXPO_CLI_SESSION_STATE=unavailable
  echo '[WatchTime preview] Replit-managed Expo CLI session: UNAVAILABLE (session secret missing); refresh the Replit workspace and restart this workflow. Do not use your Replit password as an Expo password.'
fi
EXPO_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=$CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY EXPO_PACKAGER_PROXY_URL=https://$REPLIT_EXPO_DEV_DOMAIN EXPO_PUBLIC_DOMAIN=$REPLIT_DEV_DOMAIN EXPO_PUBLIC_REPL_ID=$REPL_ID REACT_NATIVE_PACKAGER_HOSTNAME=$REPLIT_DEV_DOMAIN pnpm exec expo start --localhost --port $PORT
scripts.typecheck:api-contract: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen:check && pnpm run typecheck
